## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 5-fascicle text by [那連提耶舍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%82%A3%E9%80%A3%E6%8F%90%E8%80%B6%E8%88%8D) Narendrayaśas is the *Karuṇāpuṇḍarīka-sūtra* — one of the major Mahāyāna sūtras of *karuṇā* (compassion) doctrine. Distinct from but doctrinally related to the *Mahā-karuṇā-puṇḍarīka* tradition.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Narendrayaśas's Northern-Qí period (556–568 CE).
